newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all firmer with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all firmer with futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were all firmer on Tuesday as crude futures rose, traders said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded between $113.50 and $115 fob ARA, compared to $107-$110 on Tuesday.
Gas oil was $2 higher on futures but barge and cargo premiums were unchanged in slightly busier volumes.

Naphtha edged higher after crude rallied and traders debated whether the arbitrage to the U.S. was now open, and whether that was bullish for European prices. Gasoline rose moderately but barges were very quiet and lethargic after recent volatility.
